Preserve the single pea's identity, nearly circular slightly asymmetrical silhouette, perspective, exact framing/scale/position, major proportions and surrounding negative space. Reduce to THREE broad flat foreground color regions: dark olive green for outer contour plus connected lower-right shade, rich medium pea green for main body, warm light lime green for one broad upper-left highlight. Plain warm ivory background. No gradients, texture, speckles, glossy micro-highlights, extra colors, text, cells, guides or clues. Favor large coherent shapes with curved organic boundaries and substantial width, suitable for later 24x24 rendition; no thin isolated details. The source detailed reveal stays unchanged; output only the separate simplified motif, square composition.
